gaps.known: 24 exact BANC wing-power motor IDs and DLM/DVM target names; asynchronous muscle mechanism supported experimentally
gaps.unknown: Root-specific calcium dynamics, stretch-activation force law, recruitment, mechanical resonance and gap junctions
gaps.validation: Separate tonic drive from emergent oscillation; test zero drive, missing DLM/DVM group and energy balance, retain failure to fly.

gaps.known: 24 motor IDs with tonic/phasic steering annotation and named target muscle
gaps.unknown: Spike phase, per-muscle moment arms, stiffness effects, sign of yaw/roll/pitch in the current 3D geometry
gaps.validation: Test both declared transfer signs and unilateral/bilateral drive; never label a successful engineering sign as biological discovery.

gaps.known: 245 source proprioception labels in wing/haltere inventory, 244 proofread; exact same-detector chemical paths
gaps.unknown: Individual strain axis, threshold, phase response and direction selectivity; field-to-BANC-root mapping is incomplete
gaps.validation: Mechanical strain/phase perturbation, afferent ablation, delayed feedback and matched replay controls; preserve unknown tuning.

gaps.unknown: Pixel/optic-flow to exact-root activation, direction-tuned gains, sensory delays, bilateral visual control policy

gaps.known: Original FlyBody 3-axis wing geometry and phenomenological flight model exist as reference
gaps.unknown: Browser lift/drag/moment calibration, flexible wing deformation, hinge coupling, body mass/inertia, air-relative velocity and near-ground effects
gaps.validation: Dimensional consistency, no lift from stopped wings, symmetry tests, energy/power bounds, timestep convergence and perturbation response.

gaps.known: Landing DNs and flight-state gating are supported at cell-type level
gaps.unknown: Spontaneous takeoff/landing selection, fuel, fatigue, hunger, feeding, sleep and internal state dynamics
gaps.validation: Explicit state/energy dynamics and closed sensory feedback are required before claiming normal autonomous living.
